binance.name: Binance
binance.description: Your Binance account in OpenTrader: spot and USD-M futures balances, positions, orders and trading from the charts.

settings.label: API key
settings.help: The Binance API key. Give it trading and read permission, never withdrawals. Stored in the operating system's credential store.

settings.label: API secret
settings.help: The secret that goes with the Binance API key. Stored in the operating system's credential store.

settings.label: Network
settings.help: Testnet trades paper funds on the venue's test network. Live orders are still confirmed by OpenTrader before they are sent.

settings.label: Market
settings.help: One market per broker: switch it here and the account follows. Spot is long-only and has no position brackets.

settings.label: Refresh (seconds)
settings.help: How often the account, its orders and the ticket's quotes are refreshed.

binance.setup: In Binance > API Management, create an API key with Enable Reading and Enable Futures (or Enable Spot & Margin Trading) ticked, and withdrawals left off. Restrict it to this computer's IP, then paste the key and secret above. Paper orders on Binance testnet need a key created on testnet.binance.vision with Enable Futures.
